summary: Gate of spec-integration: 1 question, on r44 (how spec/index.md names an upstream).
questions: spec-integration r44 (new line): "[r44] **Where** `spec/index.md` names an upstream bounded-context, **when** a round of the kind `integrate` drafts a line that needs what the upstream does not yet give, `initiative-round` shall give in its result the lines of a request into that upstream, in the upstream's terms." (request q14, line 23). The line says `spec/index.md` names an upstream but not how. Readings: (a) no further line; how the index names an upstream is Implementation only (recommended: the line already fixes the behaviour and the lines of q14 do not ask for a format); (b) a field: the frontmatter of `spec/index.md` lists `upstreams: [bounded-context/<context path>, ...]` (Implementation), and the index gains an "Upstreams" section. Answer (a) gives the line as drafted; answer (b) gives the line as drafted plus that Implementation entry and index section.
